{"metadata":{"description":"Keeps a coding agent's green claims honest: verification runs are recorded unmasked, and done is blocked when the evidence is stale, failed or masked.","id":"gh:1355344668","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"stalegreen","slug":"pavangupta352/stalegreen","topics":["claude-code","claude-code-plugin","codex","coding-agents","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","hooks","typescript","verification"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Keeps a coding agent's green claims honest: verification runs are recorded unmasked, and done is blo"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"cked when the evidence is stale, failed or masked."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# stalegreen"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Hooks that keep a coding agent's green claims honest: every verification run is recorded unmasked, a"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"nd "done" is blocked when the evidence is stale, failed or masked."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Zero tokens, zero network, zero telemetry. Every verdict is deterministic and cites a receipt."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## The problem"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Coding agents say "all tests pass" a lot. Two things go wrong with that sentence, both measured on r"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" "all tests pass" a lot. Two things go wrong with that sentence, both measured on real session logs:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. **Stale green.** The test run the agent is quoting happened before its own later edits. Nothing w"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"as rerun.
2. **Masked results.** The agent piped the runner through `tail -5`, `grep`, `|| true` or "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"`; echo done`, so the exit status and the summary line never reached the transcript. The run looked "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"fine because nothing could look wrong."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Outright contradictions, where the last run failed and the agent still reported green, are rare. Sta"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"le and masked evidence is not. stalegreen is evidence hygiene: it checks the evidence behind a claim"},{"id":"p8s3","text":", not the intent behind it."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Unmask.** Before a verification command runs (`pytest`, `pnpm test`, `tsc`, `eslint`, `cargo test`"},{"id":"p10s2","text":", `go test`, `next build` and about eighty others), the PreToolUse hook rewrites it so the full outp"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ut is captured to a log, the last lines are shown to the agent, an explicit `[stalegreen] exit=<code"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"> receipt=<id>` line is printed, and the exit status is preserved. The exit status is also written n"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ext to the log, and the hook trusts that file rather than the printed line, so output text alone can"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" never create or refresh a receipt. Result-eating pipes and suffixes can no longer hide a failure. C"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ommands that cannot be wrapped safely (heredocs, backgrounding, process substitution, `sudo`, existi"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ng redirects, watch modes) are left untouched."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Receipt.** After the command finishes, the runner's own summary line and the exit status become a "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"receipt: command, runner, category, pass or fail, counts, timestamp and a working-tree fingerprint. "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"Every file edit after that is an edit event."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Freshness gate.** When the agent tries to end its turn with a claim such as "all 41 tests pass", ""},{"id":"p12s2","text":"tsc is clean", "lint passes" or "the build succeeds", the Stop hook looks up the latest receipt for "},{"id":"p12s3","text":" "lint passes" or "the build succeeds", the Stop hook looks up the latest receipt for that category:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Evidence | Verdict | Action |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Passing run, working tree unchanged since | FRESH | allow |
| Passing run, files changed since | S"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"TALE | block once, ask for a rerun |
| Failing run | FAILED | block once |
| Run whose result was no"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"t recorded (masked) | MASKED | block once, ask for an unmasked rerun |
| No run at all | NONE | allo"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"w (block in strict mode) |
| Background run still in flight | DEFERRED | allow |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"A block looks like this:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The same category is blocked at most once per turn. A second stop is allowed and recorded, so the ag"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ent can never get stuck."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"As a Claude Code plugin, from inside Claude Code:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"That registers PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop and SubagentStop from the plugin's own copy of the hook"},{"id":"p21s2","text":". Nothing is downloaded beyond the repository and nothing runs at install time; the hook has no depe"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" is downloaded beyond the repository and nothing runs at install time; the hook has no dependencies."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Or with the CLI, for Claude Code, Codex or both:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`install` copies the compiled hook to `~/.stalegreen/bin/hook.js` and registers the same four events"},{"id":"p24s2","text":": for Claude Code in `~/.claude/settings.json`, for Codex in `~/.codex/hooks.json`. Add `--project` "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"for the repository's `.claude/settings.json` or `.codex/hooks.json`, `--advisory` to record verdicts"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" without blocking. `uninstall` removes them. Use one of the two routes for Claude Code, not both, or"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" every run is recorded twice."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"For DeepSeek Harness there is a native Cordis plugin, dsh-plugin-stalegreen, listed in awesome-dsh-p"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"epSeek Harness there is a native Cordis plugin, dsh-plugin-stalegreen, listed in awesome-dsh-plugin:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## How freshness is decided"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## What counts as masking"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"A recognised verification command is masked when its runner segment is:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- piped into `tail`, `head`, `grep`, `wc`, `cut`, `awk`, `sed`, `less`, `cat` or `tee` (without `set"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" -o pipefail` the exit status is lost; `tail` keeps the summary, the filters do not),
- followed by "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"`|| true`, `|| echo ...`, `; echo done` or any `;` chain,
- sent to `/dev/null` or to a file,
- pref"},{"id":"p32s4","text":" echo ...`, `; echo done` or any `;` chain,
- sent to `/dev/null` or to a file,
- prefixed with `!`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Quiet flags (`-q`, `--silent`, `--reporter=dot`) are recorded but do not mask on their own."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## What is a claim"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The gate reads only the final assistant message. Text inside code fences, inline code and quotation "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"marks is never a claim. Questions, instructions to the user, hedged and future statements, and state"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"ments attributed to someone else are ignored:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| Sentence | Treated as |"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"| All 41 tests pass. | claim, test, all |
| `tsc --noEmit` is clean. | claim, typecheck |
| Lint and"},{"id":"p37s2","text":" typecheck both pass. | two claims |
| The tests should pass now. | hedged, ignored |
| Let me run t"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"he tests to confirm they pass. | future, ignored |
| 40 passed, 1 failed. | negated, ignored |
| Acc"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"ording to the README, all tests pass. | relayed, ignored |
| Apart from the flaky snapshot test, all"},{"id":"p37s5","text":" tests pass. | qualified, reported but never blocked |
| Do all tests pass? | question, ignored |"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"The extractor is tested against a labelled corpus of 350 sentences and must stay at or above 0.98 pr"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"ecision and 0.90 recall on assertive claims."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## What this is not"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- Not a judge of intent. It never scores anything; it checks whether the evidence behind a claim is "},{"id":"p40s2","text":"fresh and complete.
- Not a session analyzer or dashboard.
- Not a file-existence checker. Heredoc a"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"nd `sed -i` edits are invisible in transcripts, so freshness comes from the working tree, not from w"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"hat the agent said it edited."}],"truncated":true}
